data_fields.name: decal_vertex_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 6 (decal when vertex count is 6 or fewer)

data_fields.name: frame_texture_upload_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: none (unbounded: every queued texture rebuilt in one frame)

best_idea: Queue each frame's draws, sort opaque ones by program, material and mesh so state changes are rare, and draw transparent ones far to near.
decision_why: The state-sort shape fits zones with many props; the donor's transparent order (nearest first) and surface-blind sort are wrong for us and are fixed in the sketch. Duels are small (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3), so the gain is mostly zones.
acceptance: A client unit test on the draw-queue module asserts transparent items come out far to near and opaque items sharing mesh and material are contiguous; in a 375-wide zone scene the frame log shows program switches and mesh binds below the unsorted count.
